PEBench:Source_Annotations:
"SJ1 allows user to
select external power
over comm headers
or internal 3.3V power.
NB- DO NOT connect
external power to JP1
or JP2 when internal
supply is selected!"

"ADC is 5-bit 0-3.3V range.
R4 should be populated with
a 200k pot for supply
voltage compensation; see
datasheet p36 for details."

"SPI Data is MSB first,
SPI mode 3:
CPOL=CPHA=1
5 Mbit max"
"Vs must be between 8V and 45V\nMotor supply must be enabled\nfor chip comms to work!"

"SJ3 allows you to route the SDO (serial 
data out) either to the next board (if this 
board is in a chain) or back to the previous 
board (if this board is the last or only board 
in the chain). It defaults to back to previous 
board, for single board applications."

org.openpe.pebench-example.qualification: Educational source example; not a qualified PEBench production or zero-DRC sample.
org.openpe.pebench-example.changes: EAGLE schematic converted with original embedded symbol geometry, gates and physical pin mappings; PEBench KiCad PCB represented as editable structured geometry. Native source files and notices retained. Polygon curves in schematic artwork tessellated within 0.005 mm. PCB zone boundaries and settings retained; cached zone fill is regenerated by KiCad. No simulation profile is added.
